Facilities
The Department has Biocontrol and Insect Pathology lab, Taxonomy lab and molecular Entomology lab, with updated equipment. Furthermore, the Department has a separate Apiary for research on honeybees and honey production.
Our Programs
The Department offers undergraduate and graduate programs in Entomology including
B.Sc. (Hons). 4-year Bachelor Degree
M.Sc. (Hons). 2-year Master Degree
PhD. Doctoral Degree
On the Card
Establishment of Insectary (Insect rearing and Biocontrol Lab)
Short courses and trainings in Apiculture, Pest Management and Medical Entomology
Fruit fly control project
Launching of the project “Role of Nitric Oxide in the biology of nematodes (particularly insect-parasitic).
